description: Technology names that are not software a host runs: a hosting platform, a CDN or load balancer the provider operates, an analytics or tag script, a protocol or a header check. None can carry a CVE the host's owner patches, and correlation never matches them. Read only by cveFeed.tech_coverage (manage.py technology_coverage), which lists them under 'services' instead of 'unmatched', so the unmatched list holds naming gaps. A name is compared as correlation normalizes it (case and punctuation dropped), before and after a 'product/version' header token is split.
